facts.claim: Duet preserves account memory, skills and app connections and executes work in a cloud VM/browser after user devices disconnect.
Duet checks connected accounts every few hours; background checks consume plan limits and users can tune notification interests/frequency.
Duet separates Tasks from editable Make outputs; only the user marks tasks completed, and pending approval does not prevent completing other work.
Duet supports separate topic channels with shared memory and chat search; its current preview cannot display or hand over its browser.
Duet explicitly references Managed Agents credential handling and separate action review plus sensitive-message checks.
dot remains conversational while background agents execute in parallel, with adaptive continuation and saved time/event triggers.
Delegated work has selected instructions/context, its own conversation, and its original execution environment; run completion does not establish successful delivery.
Conversation context, ChatGPT saved memory and dot notes differ; channels share relevant continuity but keep distinct audience disclosure scopes.
Proactive research tools cannot send messages, change connected apps or control a browser/computer; findings return to the dot before follow-up action.
Main-task pause, delegated-task stop and recurring-schedule cancellation are distinct operations; completed external effects are not undone.
dot cloud computers preserve state and browser sessions and support takeover/return; channels, cloud/local computers and app authorization are separate connections.
Managed Agents publicly separates a durable event session, the harness loop, and sandboxes with credentials outside untrusted execution.
Managed Agents keeps queryable historical events outside the model context; harnesses may independently transform selected context.
OpenAI Agents API separately exposes a hosted harness, optional environment and application server responsibilities.
Inputs steer active turns or start new turns in idle sessions, and logical message submissions retain idempotency keys.
OpenAI Agents API multi-agent sessions share an environment filesystem and support a configured concurrency limit.

facts.product_scope: current Claude account memory; separate from legacy memory section
facts.claim: Current Claude memory uses editable Topics. Deleting a source chat does not delete its derived memory; changes to topics apply to subsequent conversations.

facts.product_scope: Claude skill ecosystem; Duet-specific synchronization timing is unconfirmed
facts.claim: Duet carries over account skills. Broader Claude documentation gives directly shared skills next-use updates and keeps organization-published skills on approved versions until updates are approved.

Turning off ChatGPT Memory sharing or disconnecting a plugin does not erase retained dot context. Dot deletion removes its own context but not every separately stored file, Codex thread or ChatGPT conversation.

facts.product_scope: OpenAI Agents API architectural analogue, not proof of dot implementation
facts.claim: Saved-agent settings are copied into new sessions. Session setting updates apply to new turns after the update; an active turn keeps its configuration even when steered.

requirements.proposal: Separate ongoing responsibility, task, activation and attempt identities.
Persist inputs before execution; deduplicate resubmissions; consume steering independently of long-running work.
Track ownership, lineage, cancellation and bounded concurrency; block only dependent branches.
Select task-relevant material with provenance and revision; preserve source history outside the context window.
Standardize model/tool loop, schema, timeout, error, effect classification and invocation IDs.
Bind each task to an explicit environment and capabilities; do not silently migrate it when defaults change.
Make authorization scope enforceable outside prompt text and limit observation-only background tools.
Separate execution return, artifact existence, acceptance and delivery states.
Unify timed, external-event and unfinished-work triggers while enforcing deduplication, backpressure and budgets.
Persist meaningful user updates separately from computation with deduplication, audience and delivery state.
Link event, work, tool, environment, artifact, latency and cost records.
Record supersession and supporting evidence when preferences, decisions or work facts change.
Discover available abilities without conflating installation, authentication and authorization.
Represent a resumable human step and explicit environment control transfer; UI streaming can follow later.
Preserve one durable responsibility identity while constraining disclosure across channel audiences.
Separate source-access revocation, source deletion, derived-memory forgetting, and whole-agent deletion; return scoped receipts and prevent stale workers from restoring forgotten context.
Record skill identities, content versions and provenance at activation; apply ordinary upgrades at a declared boundary without silently mutating active work, while honoring revocation.

limits: Managed Agents documentation does not establish the full private Duet implementation; only credential-design reuse is explicitly documented by Duet.
OpenAI Agents API documentation is an architectural reference, not proof that dot uses the identical private stack.
No claim is made about internal databases, queue technology, exact prompts, worker counts or repository implementation state.
Continuous computation requires durable evolving context and responsibilities, not only restart/resume infrastructure.

Claude skill sharing documentation describes the surrounding ecosystem; it does not establish Duet hot-reload timing. Current Claude memory behavior must be distinguished from the legacy section on the same support page.
